subject: Aurora Health MSA draft — intake and redline playbook
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MSA for Redwood Inference — first pass

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Attached is a first-pass MSA from our side (Aurora_MSA_Draft_v1.docx) plus an exhibit listing affiliates and billing contacts (ExhibitA-Parties.xlsx). A few context notes: we expect a standard SOC2 clause, a 30 day data deletion requirement post-contract, and a custom security appendix will be attached later.

Primary questions for you:
- Who on Redwood will be our contracting lead?
- Can you confirm the SLA targets we discussed (95th pctl latency and 99.9% uptime) or point me to the right doc?
- We typically need a standard indemnity carveout for regulated data — I'll highlight in red in the draft.

Can we schedule a short sync with your legal folks tomorrow afternoon? Procurement is mostly aligned but wants a high-level timeline for redlines.

Best,
Sam Park
Head of Procurement
Aurora Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft MSA for Redwood Inference — first pass

Kim / Jonas — forwarding Aurora's MSA draft and exhibit. Please treat as intake: procurement asked for a 48-hour acknowledgement and a one-week rough redline turnaround if possible. High-level asks from Aurora (from Sam): SOC2 clause, 30-day data deletion, indemnity language.

Priority items to triage:
1) Signing authority / signatories — Exhibit lists multiple affiliates; procurement flagged which legal entity will sign later. Need a quick verification of our signer rules and any approval path if >$500k ARR.
2) IP & use rights — they mention regulated data; likely need tighter residency and processing carveouts.
3) SLA / uptime ask — confirm whether we can map their targets to our hosted vs dedicated offering in the MSA.

Plan: can you do a 1-hour intake review and send back a short playbook (bullet list) of required changes and a recommended first-pass redline (tracked changes) by end of day Monday? If anything blocks, loop me and I'll escalate.

Also copying Aurora so they're aware of the timing.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments referenced: Aurora_MSA_Draft_v1.docx; ExhibitA-Parties.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 May 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MSA for Redwood Inference — first pass

On Fri, May 23, 2025 at 10:04 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kim / Jonas — forwarding Aurora's MSA draft and exhibit. Please treat as intake...

Thanks for the heads up, Marissa. Quick intake notes after a fast pass this morning:

- Signing authority: we'll need to confirm which Redwood legal entity is contracting. If multiple affiliates are involved on Exhibit A we should prefer a single Redwood entity to minimize cross-jurisdiction risk. Jonas, can you pull the entity table for AU deals?
- Data deletion (30 days): acceptable in principle but need to map to our retention policies and the Private/Hosted switch. I'll propose: "Customer data deleted within 30 days except for backup retention for up to 90 days for recovery; Redwood to provide deletion certification upon request."
- Indemnity carveouts: Aurora's draft expands indemnity for downstream regulated data processors — ask for narrowing language and cap tied to fees.
- Security appendix: request their SOC2 report, and confirm whether they need a dedicated on-prem option documented in the MSA or via a separate SOW.
- SLA mapping: their wording is for an application owner; we'll add a table mapping 'Hosted API' vs 'Dedicated' service levels and fallback behavior.

Requested deliverables from Legal by EOD Monday (on fast-track):
1) Intake playbook (2–3 bullets per risk area)
2) Tracked redline (first pass) with comment flags for commercial team
3) A short list of info we need from Aurora (SOC2 report, signing entity, expected seat count, billing entity)

I'll attach a redline skeleton and a one-page intake checklist. If procurement needs a call, I'm available Tuesday 11–12 or Wednesday morning.

Kimberly Park
Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: redline_skeleton.docx (stub)

From: Sam Park <sam.park@aurorahealth.com>

Marissa / Kim — thanks for the quick acknowledgement and the plan. Appreciate the proposed deletion language, that sounds reasonable. Our procurement lead (procurement@aurorahealth.com) asked me to confirm:

- We will provide SOC2 Type II report and a security appendix draft by EOD Monday.
- Signing entity: Aurora Health Solutions, Inc. (listed on Exhibit A).
- Seat count estimate: initial pilot 50 users, expected to ramp to 600 by Q4 (will include in Exhibit A final).

We can do a 30-minute sync Tuesday at 11:15am PT with procurement and your legal. I've booked a placeholder calendar invite and attached a DocuSign link placeholder for later signature.

Best regards,
Sam Park
Head of Procurement | Aurora Health
sam.park@aurorahealth.com
